from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pickle
DATA_PATH = Path('../out/raw_percents')
In [10]:
for file in DATA_PATH.iterdir():
    data = pickle.load(file.open('rb'))
    for name in data:
        if name == 'all':
            continue
        xs = list(data[name].keys())
        ys = [float(data[name][x][0] / data[name][x][1]) for x in xs]
        plt.plot(xs, ys, label=name)
        plt.xlabel('Magnitude Sparsity')
        plt.ylabel('% Salient Pruned')
        plt.legend()
        plt.title(f'{round((1-float(file.stem))*100)}% highest activations')
    plt.show()
